<think>**Designing explicit state transitions**

**Factoring output logic**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_fsm_sync (
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input start,
    input [7:0] data_in,
    output reg [7:0] data_out,
    output reg done
);

localparam [8:0] S_IDLE  = 9'b000000001;
localparam [8:0] S_START = 9'b000000010;
localparam [8:0] S_READ  = 9'b000000100;
localparam [8:0] S_PROC1 = 9'b000001000;
localparam [8:0] S_PROC2 = 9'b000010000;
localparam [8:0] S_PROC3 = 9'b000100000;
localparam [8:0] S_WAIT  = 9'b001000000;
localparam [8:0] S_DONE  = 9'b010000000;
localparam [8:0] S_ERROR = 9'b100000000;

reg [8:0] state, next_state;

always @(*) begin
    next_state = S_IDLE;
    case (state)
        S_IDLE:  next_state = start ? S_START : S_IDLE;
        S_START: next_state = data_in[0] ? S_READ : S_ERROR;
        S_READ:  next_state = (data_in[3:1] == 3'b101) ? S_PROC1 : S_WAIT;
        S_PROC1: next_state = S_PROC2;
        S_PROC2: next_state = data_in[7] ? S_PROC3 : S_WAIT;
        S_PROC3: next_state = S_DONE;
        S_WAIT:  next_state = data_in[4] ? S_READ : S_WAIT;
        S_DONE:  next_state = S_IDLE;
        S_ERROR: next_state = (data_in[2:0] == 3'b111) ? S_IDLE : S_ERROR;
        default: next_state = S_IDLE;
    endcase
end

wire select_read = (state == S_READ);
wire select_done = (state == S_DONE);
wire select_inc = (state == S_PROC1);
wire select_shift = (state == S_PROC2);
wire select_invert = (state == S_PROC3);
wire select_error = (state == S_ERROR);
wire select_pass = select_read | select_done;

wire [7:0] incremented;
assign incremented[0] = ~data_in[0];
genvar i;
generate
    for (i = 1; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin : g_increment
        assign incremented[i] = data_in[i] ^ (&data_in[i-1:0]);
    end
endgenerate

always @(*) begin
    data_out = ({8{select_pass}} & data_in)
             | ({8{select_inc}} & incremented)
             | ({8{select_shift}} & {data_in[6:0], 1'b0})
             | ({8{select_invert}} & ~data_in)
             | ({8{select_error}} & 8'hEE);
    done = select_done;
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rst)
        state <= S_IDLE;
    else
        state <= next_state;
end

endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The targeted path is the combinational data_in-to-data_out increment path followed by state-selected output logic. The original addition can map into a serial carry structure; the actual limiting path requires mapped STA confirmation.",
  "rewrite": "Express increment-by-one using explicit prefix-AND carry conditions and XORs. Express the output selection as parallel masked terms, sharing the identical READ and DONE data paths. Retain the original state register, state encodings, next-state case, and synchronous reset.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Explicit reduction-based carry conditions give mapping an opportunity to use balanced AND trees instead of a serial carry chain. Parallel output terms also expose direct AND/OR mapping. Positive WNS improvement is expected if the increment/output path is limiting, but no numerical gain or signoff result is claimed without synthesis and STA.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "No additional registers, latency, clocks, or helper modules. Prefix reductions may increase combinational area or input fanout relative to a compact incrementer. Compliance with the 1102.432320um2 cap and electrical limits must be checked after mapping.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves all ports, unsigned widths, nine named state encodings, synchronous active-high reset, and combinational output behavior. Increment results are exactly modulo 256. Exact state comparisons preserve zero outputs and the S_IDLE next-state default for every invalid defined state, including arbitrary initial states. No startup assumptions, initialization, or additional state are introduced."
}
